Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice; inadvertently forgetting the stove is mere negligence, not intentional or reckless burning.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not formal binding sources; they are material sources that may evidence or enunciate customary law.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if… may re-enter” is conditional language plus a right of entry, creating a fee simple subject to condition subsequent.
